changelog:
Initial release of long-text-summarizer — a skill for reliable, structured summarization of documents exceeding single-model context.

- Implements Map/Reduce plus hierarchical reduction for long/ultra-long texts.
- Supports format, length, tone, and focus customization in output summaries.
- Provides detailed workflow: chunking, per-chunk mapping, multi-level reduction.
- Offers batch document summarization and specialized prompts for output control.
- Includes self-improving workflow: usage reflection and guidance for iterative SKILL.md improvements.
summary: 长文/超长文档摘要技能。基于 Map/Reduce 与分层归约(hierarchical reduce)把超出模型上下文的 文本可靠地浓缩成结构化摘要；支持按格式/长度/语气/聚焦维度定制输出。当需要摘要论文、报告、 书籍、聊天记录、长网页、批量文档时使用。
